tips: Hold B, or either Ctrl key, on the campaign map to open the radial menu at the mouse. Point at an ability and release the key to use it.
The radial menu's hotkeys can be changed in LunaLib's mod settings, under Campaign Radial Menu. You can also set a mouse button to open it.
Hold the left mouse button on a radial menu slot for half a second to give it another ability or empty it. Slots on the main ring can also become submenus.
A radial menu submenu opens on an outer ring as soon as you point at it. Move outward to pick one of its abilities, or back to the center to close it.
Release the radial menu's hotkey in the center, or press Escape, to close it without using anything.
Rest the mouse on an ability in the radial menu to see its tooltip, and press F1 for more detail. Pausing, the slot counts and the look of the wheel are all in LunaLib's mod settings.
